overall_notes: This paper focuses on rumor detection using LLMs with multi-perspective analysis generation. While the primary task is classification (rumor detection), the paper includes NLG components through the generation of explanatory analyses from multiple perspectives. The evaluation uses standard classification metrics (F1, Accuracy) but no human or LLM-as-judge evaluation. The extraction quality was generally good with minor normalization needed.
